note: Real terminal recordings (VHS) and real screenshots from one run of the repo's fixture apps; cards, subtitles, badges and grid layout composited with Remotion. Source: marketing/demo-video/README.md

clips.title: Is this Mac ready?
clips.description: shotfleet doctor --fix checks Maestro, Java, Xcode and the Android SDK, and fetches what is missing after asking once.
facts: Run on 2026-10-05 on an Apple silicon Mac (M1 Pro): every doctor line ok, 'iOS: ready   Android: ready'.

clips.title: Set up a project
clips.description: shotfleet init reads an iOS simulator build and an Android APK, lists the languages each one has, and writes a config and an English flow.
facts: init found 5 languages (ar, de, en, ja, tr) in the fixture app's iOS build and in its Android APK.

clips.title: Every language on iPhone
clips.description: The English Maestro flow runs in every language the app has, on several iPhone simulators at once. Then every screenshot is checked.
facts: 2026-10-06: 5 of 5 languages captured on 2 iPhone 17 Pro Max simulators (iOS 26.4) in 253 s, 10 screenshots, 0 problems.
shotfleet used 2 simulators instead of 4 because the Mac was short on memory; it says so on screen.
No iPad set in this run, so check prints the App Store's 13-inch iPad requirement.

clips.title: Every language on Android
clips.description: The same English flow runs in every language on Android emulators. Then every screenshot is checked.
facts: 2026-10-06: 5 of 5 languages captured on 2 Android phone emulators (1080x1920) in 3 rounds, 94 s, 10 screenshots, 0 problems, one non-blocking Play note.

clips.title: Catching the wrong language
clips.description: I put a German screenshot in the Japanese folder, and shotfleet check caught it. The real output passes with 0 problems.
facts: A copy of the Android output with the German welcome screenshot placed in the Japanese folder: 2 problems ('shows de strings', identical image in 2 languages). The real output: 0 problems.

clips.title: Checking screenshots you already have
clips.description: shotfleet check reads fastlane folders or a plain folder of screenshots. You don't need a simulator for this.
facts: Two Japanese screenshots in a plain folder labelled --locale de: check reports both as showing Japanese strings. No simulator used.

clips.title: Store rules
clips.description: shotfleet check flags screenshot sizes the stores refuse. It also flags a missing 13-inch iPad set.
facts: iPhone-only output of an app that runs on iPad: the 13-inch iPad requirement is reported. One screenshot resized to 1000x2000: 'isn't an App Store screenshot size'.

clips.title: Export to fastlane
clips.description: One command puts the passing Google Play screenshots into fastlane's folders.
facts: The 10 passing Android screenshots copied into fastlane/metadata/android/<locale>/images/phoneScreenshots/. The iOS set was not exported: export needs the iPad set the App Store requires.

clips.title: In CI
clips.description: The GitHub Actions setup from the docs, with the --json result and the exit code from check.
facts: The workflow file is the recipe from site/public/docs.html, shown, not run on GitHub here. check --json on the Android output: exit code 0.
